summary.text: Earth Shuttle is Fang clan's rank seven earth path Immortal Gu House. Wan Xiao names it as the house that wrecked tall pine oasis's formation base.

claims.text: Before the house is named, Wan Xiao finds an earth path Immortal Gu House wreaking havoc underground at tall pine oasis and destroying the formation base buried deep under that defensive formation. Light from Wan clan strikes the underground house as well, and Wan clan’s first supreme elder judges its defense weak even while blaming the underground invasion on that earth path Immortal Gu House.
Fang clan later counts that it already had three Immortal Gu Houses and had added an earth path Immortal Gu House.

When Earth Shuttle is mobilized in the anti-Fang alliance battle, Fang Chen and Fang An Lei fly out and enter it. Wan Xiao changes target and hurls long-prepared berserk wind blades at it; Earth Shuttle endures them without dodging and charges the enemy formation. Alliance Gu Immortals evade rather than collide with a rank seven Immortal Gu House, and every aspect of Earth Shuttle has been strengthened since the tall pine oasis attack, including defense that had been very weak then. Dealing with this earth path Immortal Gu House was already in Wan clan’s plans. Mo Sha Ta blocks it with a killer move that piles dense sand on it and cuts its speed; Earth Shuttle shakes the sand off and charges him until he flees. Xiao Ye Hu then aims Chamber Pot at Earth Shuttle and releases a pitch-black lump of light; Fallen Flower Hall slows it with fleeting bloom, and Earth Shuttle evades.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Earth Shuttle is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile equipment of Fang clan, not a five-region map seat.

Earth Shuttle streaks across the battlefield as a yellow meteor and nearly kills Shi Kang until Lin Shu Tong collides into it and forces a course change. When Xiao Ye Hu is about to use Chamber Pot on Fang Gong outside an Immortal Gu House, Earth Shuttle comes crashing over and forces Xiao Ye Hu to retreat and protect himself.
